name: peepcraft
description: Draw Open Peeps characters and scenes in the browser, from the terminal, or from an AI agent.

scripts.test: npm test --workspaces && node --test examples/*.test.ts examples/peeps-cli/*.test.ts examples/peeps-mcp/*.test.ts
scripts.perf:peeps: node examples/peeps/build.mjs && node scripts/budget.ts --dist examples/peeps/dist --kind tool --tap ".pc-rail [role=tab]:nth-child(2)"
scripts.dev:mcp: node examples/peeps-mcp/build.mjs && npx wrangler@4 dev -c examples/peeps-mcp/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:mcp: node examples/peeps-mcp/build.mjs && npx wrangler@4 deploy -c examples/peeps-mcp/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:peeps: node examples/peeps/build.mjs && npx -y wrangler@4 pages deploy examples/peeps/dist --project-name peepcraft --branch "$(git branch --show-current)" --commit-dirty=true
